{
  "problem_id": "TA-003",
  "lane_id": "openai-raw",
  "provider": "openai",
  "model_or_runtime": "OpenAI frontier reasoning-model ensemble via API, with tool-using research agents, retrieval, theorem-prover interfaces, code execution, and isolated replication agents",
  "execution_posture": "non_governed",
  "estimated_input_tokens": 12000000000,
  "estimated_output_tokens": 3000000000,
  "estimated_reasoning_tokens": 45000000000,
  "estimated_candidate_branches": 18000,
  "estimated_failed_branches": 17500,
  "estimated_retries": 40000,
  "estimated_search_cost": 180000,
  "estimated_governance_overhead": 0,
  "estimated_verification_cost": 1200000,
  "estimated_total_cost_low": 1500000,
  "estimated_total_cost_central": 6500000,
  "estimated_total_cost_high": 40000000,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_low": 8760,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_central": 35040,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_high": 87600,
  "estimated_success_probability": 0.0003,
  "estimated_reproduction_probability": 0.0,
  "estimated_independent_result_probability": 0.0003,
  "confidence": 0.16,
  "assumptions": [
    "The target is a rigorous construction of a group proved not to be sofic under a standard equivalent definition, at a level suitable for publication in a leading research journal.",
    "No accepted published construction of a non-sofic group is assumed available for reproduction; consequently, success would constitute an independent breakthrough rather than reconstruction of a known proof.",
    "The estimate covers broad literature ingestion in geometric, measured, combinatorial, and operator-algebraic group theory; extraction of known obstructions; exploratory conjecture generation; computational experiments; failed proof branches; proof repair; manuscript preparation; and replication.",
    "Reasoning tokens are reported separately but may be billed by the API as output or internal reasoning tokens depending on the selected model.",
    "Total costs include model inference, retrieval infrastructure, licensed literature access, symbolic and numerical computation, theorem-prover integration, artifact storage, specialist consultation, independent mathematical review, and contingency.",
    "Search cost covers literature retrieval, database access, citation-graph exploration, experimental compute, and broad candidate-family screening.",
    "Verification cost covers adversarial critic agents, independent proof reconstruction, consistency checks across equivalent definitions of soficity, formalization of critical lemmas, clean-room replication, and specialist review.",
    "Because the lane is non-governed, no cost is assigned to identity hashing, budget-enforcement controls, branch receipts, evidence-preservation policy, or policy checks; ordinary research logging and publication verification remain included elsewhere.",
    "Elapsed time is wall-clock time under substantial parallelism, not aggregate agent-hours.",
    "The probability estimate is prospective and does not claim observed autonomous feasibility."
  ],
  "uncertainty_drivers": [
    "The existence of non-sofic groups is a longstanding open problem, so there is no demonstrated proof architecture or reliable measure of distance to a solution.",
    "A successful proof may require a new invariant, obstruction, construction paradigm, or connection between currently separate areas rather than scaling known search methods.",
    "Non-soficity requires ruling out all sufficiently accurate finite approximations, creating a difficult universal negative statement with weak prospects for finite computational certification.",
    "Candidate constructions may depend on deep unproved conjectures or produce only weaker properties that do not imply non-soficity.",
    "Current model competence on long, novel, dependency-heavy research proofs and on detecting subtle quantifier or approximation errors is uncertain.",
    "Formalization effort could range from manageable verification of a few new lemmas to rebuilding extensive analytic and group-theoretic infrastructure.",
    "API pricing, model capability, context limits, tool reliability, and availability of stronger future models could materially change both cost and probability.",
    "Human specialist availability and the number of independent reviews required for acceptance are difficult to forecast.",
    "The problem could be substantially harder than the high estimate, or conceivably obstructed by foundational independence phenomena."
  ],
  "minimum_evidence": [
    "An explicit, unambiguous construction or presentation of the proposed group, together with a proof that the construction defines the claimed group.",
    "A complete proof that the group violates a standard definition of soficity, with every quantifier and approximation parameter handled explicitly.",
    "A checked derivation connecting any newly introduced obstruction to established equivalent formulations of soficity.",
    "Resolution of all dependencies without relying on unproved conjectures or unverifiable computational claims.",
    "At least two clean-room proof reconstructions by independent critic or verifier teams that did not share intermediate reasoning traces.",
    "Machine-checkable formalization of the central obstruction and the most error-sensitive lemmas, or an explicit technical justification for any portions that cannot reasonably be formalized.",
    "Reproducible code, data, search logs, and computational certificates for every experiment used as more than heuristic motivation.",
    "Adversarial testing against known sofic classes, limiting cases, quotient and extension pitfalls, and alternative conventions in the literature.",
    "A publication-ready manuscript with complete definitions, dependency mapping, error analysis, and a clear account of novelty.",
    "Independent expert review concluding that the argument actually establishes non-soficity rather than a nearby weaker property."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "There is no known published proof to reproduce, making the reproduction probability zero under the stated interpretation.",
    "Known candidate families may all be sofic or may resist available obstruction techniques.",
    "Computational search cannot directly certify the required asymptotic universal failure of finite approximations.",
    "Subtle errors involving ultraproducts, approximation metrics, asymptotic quantifiers, or closure properties could survive multiple automated critic passes.",
    "The theorem-prover ecosystem may lack sufficient libraries for the analytic and group-theoretic machinery required.",
    "Autonomous agents may repeatedly rediscover equivalent dead ends or mistake conditional constructions for unconditional examples.",
    "Independent mathematical reviewers may be unable to validate a proof whose novel machinery is too extensive or insufficiently formalized.",
    "The required conceptual advance may lie outside the effective exploration range of current OpenAI models regardless of allocated inference."
  ]
}
